title_en: Simulation-Free Schrödinger Bridges via Score and Flow Matching
title_zh: 通过得分匹配与流匹配实现免模拟薛定谔桥

verified_metadata.title: Simulation-Free Schrödinger Bridges via Score and Flow Matching
verified_metadata.journal: Proceedings of The 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics
verified_metadata.abstract: [SF]2M trains Schrödinger bridge vector fields and scores from static endpoint couplings, avoiding simulation of the learned process during training.

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Alexander Y. Tong、Nikolay Malkin、Kilian Fatras、Lazar Atanackovic、Yanlei Zhang、Guillaume Huguet、Guy Wolf、Yoshua Bengio；AISTATS 2024, PMLR 238, 1279–1287；对应 arXiv:2307.03672v3。核验全文29页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: Schrödinger bridge在两个任意分布之间寻找entropy-regularized最优随机过程，但许多算法训练时要反复模拟当前SDE并拟合其marginals，代价高且误差累积。能否只采样静态endpoint pairs和解析conditional paths，同时学习probability-flow ODE与stochastic bridge SDE？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: conditional flow matching可从简单的条件路径回归marginal velocity；score matching可学习同一路径的score。若endpoint coupling取Schrödinger/entropic OT coupling，对每对(x0,x1)使用Brownian-bridge-like Gaussian conditional，混合后的marginals就是目标bridge。
‘simulation-free’限定于training objective不需从当前learned process rollout；生成或评估动态时仍要数值积分ODE/SDE。真实Schrödinger coupling通常未知，论文用minibatch entropic OT近似，因此仍有batch bias和Sinkhorn计算。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: [SF]²M联合回归conditional probability-flow velocity与score，边缘化后得到同一marginal path的ODE和正/反向SDE。源—目标pair由static entropic OT coupling采样；作者证明在全局optimum下目标等价于对应Schrödinger bridge。
实验包括二维distribution transport、Gaussian ground truth、single-cell time-course interpolation/trajectory、Waddington landscape和gene regulatory network recovery；与DSB、IPF、OT-CFM等方法比较Wasserstein、NPE、MMD与生物指标。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1显示8-Gaussians到moons的ODE与SDE trajectories，并说明同一网络体系可产生deterministic flow和stochastic bridge。Table 1突出训练时无需模拟或预训练score的算法差异。
Figure 2从scRNA-seq bridge提取time-dependent Waddington landscape；Tables 4–5在多套单细胞数据上比较distribution fit与held-out timepoint interpolation。[SF]²M整体有竞争力，但并非每个指标都统一最佳。
Figure 3从给定cell模拟多条未来轨迹，并将velocity-derived Granger关系用于GRN recovery；后续表格显示在synthetic networks上可恢复部分边。结果支持方法兼顾分布与动态推断，但生物因果解释仍依赖模型与观测时间分辨率。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 理论等价要求函数类达到global optimum且endpoint coupling正确；minibatch OT并非全数据Schrödinger coupling，regularization、batch size与cost选择都会改变bridge。score/velocity estimation误差及ODE/SDE discretization仍影响结果。
single-cell snapshots没有真实cell lineage，识别的trajectory和landscape是模型解释而非直接观察。GRN recovery由velocity derivatives推断，不能替代干预因果验证；高维Sinkhorn成本、feature metric和时间不等间隔也是实践限制。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定OT cost/ε、minibatch size、conditional variance schedule、ODE/SDE solver与steps、network/optimizer、cell preprocessing/PCA、timepoint split、seeds及各benchmark metric。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–3 Figure 1与贡献；pp.3–6看score/flow matching推导；pp.6–10读Tables 1–5和细胞结果；pp.11–15看结论与实验细节；pp.16–29为证明和补充实验。
